package answer

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestDecodeTaskTestAnswerPayloadAcceptsSupportedKinds(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		task    *TaskMetadata
		payload string
	}{
		{
			name:    "single choice",
			task:    assessmentTask("test", "single_choice"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","variant_id":"variant-a"}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "ordering",
			task:    assessmentTask("ordering", "ordering"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","ordered_variant_ids":["variant-b","variant-a"]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "classification",
			task:    assessmentTask("classification", "classification"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"variant-a","group_id":"group-id"},{"variant_id":"variant-b","group_id":"group-b"}]}]}`,
		},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := decodeTaskTestAnswerPayload(test.task, json.RawMessage(test.payload)); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("decode supported payload: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDecodeTaskTestAnswerPayloadRejectsInvalidShape(t *testing.T) {
	task := assessmentTask("test", "single_choice")
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		payload string
	}{
		{name: "empty", payload: `{}`},
		{name: "unknown question", payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"other","variant_id":"variant-a"}]}`},
		{name: "unknown variant", payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","variant_id":"other-variant"}]}`},
		{name: "mixed forms", payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","variant_id":"variant-a","ordered_variant_ids":["variant-a"]}]}`},
		{name: "unknown field", payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","variant_id":"variant-a","is_correct":true}]}`},
		{name: "trailing document", payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","variant_id":"variant-a"}]} {}`},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := decodeTaskTestAnswerPayload(task, json.RawMessage(test.payload))
			if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("error = %v, want validation", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDecodeTaskTestAnswerPayloadRejectsInvalidStructuredReferences(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		task    *TaskMetadata
		payload string
	}{
		{
			name:    "ordering is incomplete",
			task:    assessmentTask("ordering", "ordering"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","ordered_variant_ids":["variant-a"]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "ordering repeats a variant",
			task:    assessmentTask("ordering", "ordering"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","ordered_variant_ids":["variant-a","variant-a"]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "ordering references an unknown variant",
			task:    assessmentTask("ordering", "ordering"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","ordered_variant_ids":["variant-a","other-variant"]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "ordering references a variant from another question",
			task:    crossQuestionOrderingTask(),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-a","ordered_variant_ids":["a-a","b-b"]},{"test_id":"question-b","ordered_variant_ids":["b-a","a-b"]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "classification is incomplete",
			task:    assessmentTask("classification", "classification"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"variant-a","group_id":"group-id"}]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "classification repeats a variant",
			task:    assessmentTask("classification", "classification"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"variant-a","group_id":"group-id"},{"variant_id":"variant-a","group_id":"group-b"}]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "classification references an unknown group",
			task:    assessmentTask("classification", "classification"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"variant-a","group_id":"group-id"},{"variant_id":"variant-b","group_id":"other-group"}]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "classification references an unknown variant",
			task:    assessmentTask("classification", "classification"),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"other-variant","group_id":"group-id"},{"variant_id":"variant-b","group_id":"group-b"}]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "classification references a variant from another question",
			task:    crossQuestionClassificationTask(),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-a","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"a-a","group_id":"a-group-a"},{"variant_id":"b-b","group_id":"a-group-b"}]},{"test_id":"question-b","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"b-a","group_id":"b-group-a"},{"variant_id":"a-b","group_id":"b-group-b"}]}]}`,
		},
		{
			name:    "classification references a group from another question",
			task:    crossQuestionClassificationTask(),
			payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-a","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"a-a","group_id":"b-group-a"},{"variant_id":"a-b","group_id":"a-group-b"}]},{"test_id":"question-b","group_assignments":[{"variant_id":"b-a","group_id":"a-group-a"},{"variant_id":"b-b","group_id":"b-group-b"}]}]}`,
		},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := decodeTaskTestAnswerPayload(test.task, json.RawMessage(test.payload))
			if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("error = %v, want validation", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNormalizeTaskMetadataSupportsStructuredAssessmentTypes(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		taskType int16
		kind     string
	}{
		{taskType: 11, kind: "test"},
		{taskType: 12, kind: "ordering"},
		{taskType: 13, kind: "classification"},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			metadata := NormalizeTaskMetadata(&TaskMetadata{Type: test.taskType})
			if metadata.TaskKind != test.kind {
				t.Fatalf("task kind = %q, want %q", metadata.TaskKind, test.kind)
			}
			if metadata.ExecutionMode != "NO_RUN" || metadata.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || metadata.UIMode != "QUIZ" || metadata.SubmissionMode != "ANSWER_PAYLOAD" {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected assessment modes: %+v", metadata)
			}
			if metadata.RequiresSandbox || metadata.ExposesPreview || metadata.ExposesTerminal || metadata.SupportsLiveValidation {
				t.Fatalf("assessment exposes runtime capabilities: %+v", metadata)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestFinalValidationRejectsMalformedAssessmentBeforeUpdatingAnswer(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		payload string
	}{
		{name: "wrong shape", payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","variant_id":"variant-id"}]}`},
		{name: "unknown variant", payload: `{"answers":[{"test_id":"question-id","ordered_variant_ids":["variant-a","other-variant"]}]}`},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			repo := &taskAnswerGuardRepoStub{
				answers: map[string]*domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
					"answer-id": {
						ID: "answer-id", StudentID: "student-id", TaskID: "task-id",
						Status: domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress,
					},
				},
				progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{},
			}
			provider := progressionTaskProviderStub{tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
				"task-id": assessmentTask("ordering", "ordering"),
			}}
			provider.tasks["task-id"].ID = "task-id"
			provider.tasks["task-id"].Status = domain.TaskStatusActive
			provider.tasks["task-id"].SubmissionMode = taskSubmissionAnswerPayload
			selections := &assessmentVariantRepoStub{}

			err := (FinalValidation{Answers: repo, TaskTestAnswers: selections, TaskProvider: provider}).Handle(
				context.Background(),
				"answer-id",
				json.RawMessage(test.payload),
			)
			if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("error = %v, want validation", err)
			}
			if repo.updated {
				t.Fatal("malformed assessment updated the answer before validation")
			}
			if selections.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("malformed assessment replaced persisted selections %d times", selections.calls)
			}
			if len(repo.answers["answer-id"].AnswerPayload) != 0 || repo.answers["answer-id"].Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress {
				t.Fatalf("answer mutated after malformed payload: %+v", repo.answers["answer-id"])
			}
		})
	}
}

func assessmentTask(taskKind, questionKind string) *TaskMetadata {
	task := &TaskMetadata{
		TaskKind: taskKind,
		Tests: []TaskTestMetadata{{
			ID: "question-id", Kind: questionKind,
			Variants: []TaskTestVariantMetadata{
				{ID: "variant-a"},
				{ID: "variant-b"},
			},
		}},
	}
	if questionKind == assessmentKindClassification {
		task.Tests[0].Groups = []TaskTestGroupMetadata{{ID: "group-id"}, {ID: "group-b"}}
	}
	return task
}

func crossQuestionOrderingTask() *TaskMetadata {
	return &TaskMetadata{
		TaskKind: assessmentKindOrdering,
		Tests: []TaskTestMetadata{
			{
				ID: "question-a", Kind: assessmentKindOrdering,
				Variants: []TaskTestVariantMetadata{{ID: "a-a"}, {ID: "a-b"}},
			},
			{
				ID: "question-b", Kind: assessmentKindOrdering,
				Variants: []TaskTestVariantMetadata{{ID: "b-a"}, {ID: "b-b"}},
			},
		},
	}
}

func crossQuestionClassificationTask() *TaskMetadata {
	return &TaskMetadata{
		TaskKind: assessmentKindClassification,
		Tests: []TaskTestMetadata{
			{
				ID: "question-a", Kind: assessmentKindClassification,
				Groups:   []TaskTestGroupMetadata{{ID: "a-group-a"}, {ID: "a-group-b"}},
				Variants: []TaskTestVariantMetadata{{ID: "a-a"}, {ID: "a-b"}},
			},
			{
				ID: "question-b", Kind: assessmentKindClassification,
				Groups:   []TaskTestGroupMetadata{{ID: "b-group-a"}, {ID: "b-group-b"}},
				Variants: []TaskTestVariantMetadata{{ID: "b-a"}, {ID: "b-b"}},
			},
		},
	}
}
